summary: Election petition threshold rejection; Section 81(3) compliance: true attested copies required but Rule 212 of Kerala HC Rules procedural; non-compliance not fatal under Section 86(1); Section 83 material facts requirement curable; triable issue under Section 123(3) established regarding religious symbol in slips; appeal dismissed; HC order upholding election petition validity sustained.
legal_provisions_cited: Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.7
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order allowing trial of election petition on issue of religious symbol misuse under Section 123(3) upheld.
